title: Codex CLI 0.147 Agent Plugin Compatibility Spike
scope: Codex CLI installation, plugin browser/search/install, update/reinstall, and offline publisher fallback

officialSources.evidence: Official quickstart documents installing Codex CLI and rerunning the installer to update it.
Official docs specify codex /plugins, configured marketplaces, plugin search/install, and a new session after installation.
Official docs define event-specific JSON output and say background-hook output is delivered at the next safe point, not as a new turn.

localProbe.packageEvidence: OpenAI.Codex_26.818.5229.0_x64__2p2nqsd0c76g0; resources also contain codex and codex.exe binaries.
localProbe.cliExecutionEvidence: codex --version and codex --help both failed with WindowsApps access denied, including an escalated read-only retry.
localProbe.wslShellEvidence: wsl -d Ubuntu started successfully and command -v codex resolved /mnt/c/Program Files/WindowsApps/.../resources/codex.
localProbe.wslExecutionEvidence: Within the available WSL shell, codex --version and codex --help resolved to the mounted WindowsApps binary and both failed with Permission denied.
localProbe.nonDestructiveProbeEvidence: Publisher exposes --dry-run, --verify, --write, --register, and --codex-cli; no install/update command was executed.

matrix.localEvidence: Installed Store package resolves on PATH.
Execution blocked by WindowsApps access denied.
Cannot execute installed binary, so interactive search/list was not claimed as locally verified.

matrix.officialCommand: codex /plugins; select a configured marketplace plugin; start a new session
matrix.localEvidence: Cannot execute installed binary; repository publisher remains file-based and local.

matrix.officialCommand: Rerun the official Codex installer; do not infer a version migration from news.
matrix.localEvidence: Not executed because it downloads or mutates installation state.
Core publisher is Python stdlib/file based; --register explicitly requires a resolvable Codex executable, while publish/verify do not require one. Existing publish_local tests cover this boundary.

decision.reason: The installed Windows package is present and WSL can locate its mounted CLI binary, but Windows and WSL execution are blocked by package permissions; official docs prove plugin-browser semantics, while local search/update behavior remains unverified.
decision.nextVerification: Run codex --version, codex /plugins search/install, and a controlled update/reinstall on a host where the standalone CLI is executable; then append observed evidence without removing the publisher fallback.
